observations.event: Read-only socket inspection during the second attempt
observations.finding: The empty native listen-interface preference resolves to the IPv4 wildcard. A dual-stack Docker network does not by itself change this client default.
observations.observer_note: A short Python process inside the client read /proc/net. The outer Docker command took 0.235 seconds including setup. This extra inspection may contribute a small CPU/RSS/anonymous-memory observer cost to this attempt; it is retained and disclosed. No other timed attempt receives this manual inspection.
